author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Like the effects you see on the battlefield? https://deadlyprintstudio.com/ has got you covered! Not only that from May 12th to May 31st you can save 20% on your order. Use code PLAYON20 to save on your next order!

16,400 points total! 4 players on 2 teams. 3,000 points per player and 1 Reaver Titan per side. This is HUGE! This is the Return of Apocalypse. 

This epic battle will begin with Tycho and Tyranids facing Nick with his Astra Militarum. Mid battle reinforcements will arrive in the form of Mubin, for Tycho, and he brings the Thousand Sons, and Tak, for Nick, and he brings Ultramarines. Mid battle the Reaver Titans also enter the fray. This is gonna be Apocalyptic!
